Typical application development lifecycle

Diagram
flowchart LR
    A[Define requirements] --> B[Set up project and environment]
    B --> C[Design architecture and data]
    C --> D[Build interface and logic]
    D --> E[Integrate platform services]
    E --> F[Test and debug]
    F --> G[Configure security and operations]
    G --> H[Deploy]
    H --> I[Monitor and improve]
    I --> C

This is the typical high-level flow, but the exact tools, commands, environments, review gates, and deployment steps depend on the platform. Please provide its name or a link for a platform-specific walkthrough.
